Third-party software in the Skillroy Test (Java) command line distribution
============================================================================

The project's own code in this distribution (bin/skillroy and the lib/skillroy-*.jar files) is licensed under the
Apache License, Version 2.0; see LICENSE and NOTICE at the top level of this distribution.

The jars below are third-party software. They are in lib/, they are copied here unmodified, and each carries the
licence and attribution files its authors ship inside the jar (META-INF/LICENSE, META-INF/NOTICE and the others
named in the second table). Please keep the jars as they are: do not repack, shade or minimise them.

Redistributed artifacts
-----------------------

Each line is: Maven coordinates (group:artifact:version), SPDX licence identifier, file in this distribution.
The line format is read by a test; see "Keeping this file correct" below.

com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-annotations:2.22             Apache-2.0   lib/jackson-annotations-2.22.jar
com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-core:2.22.3                  Apache-2.0   lib/jackson-core-2.22.3.jar
com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind:2.22.3              Apache-2.0   lib/jackson-databind-2.22.3.jar
com.fasterxml.jackson.dataformat:jackson-dataformat-yaml:2.22.3 Apache-2.0   lib/jackson-dataformat-yaml-2.22.3.jar
org.yaml:snakeyaml:2.5                                          Apache-2.0   lib/snakeyaml-2.5.jar

Attributions
------------

Jackson (the four com.fasterxml.jackson jars): Copyright 2007-, Tatu Saloranta; developed by a community of
developers. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. See META-INF/NOTICE and META-INF/LICENSE inside each jar.

SnakeYAML: YAML 1.1 parser and emitter for Java, https://bitbucket.org/snakeyaml/snakeyaml. Licensed under the
Apache License, Version 2.0. The jar contains no licence file of its own; its manifest (Bundle-License) and its
embedded POM name that licence. The licence text is the LICENSE file at the top level of this distribution.

Components embedded in jackson-core
-----------------------------------

The jackson-core jar contains code from the following projects, each under its own permissive licence. The
licence texts are the files named below, inside the jar; they must stay with it.

Each line is: component, SPDX licence identifier, file inside lib/jackson-core-2.22.3.jar.

  FastDoubleParser (shaded copy, by Werner Randelshofer)       MIT           META-INF/FastDoubleParser-LICENSE
  Schubfach number writing code (by Raffaello Giulietti)       MIT           META-INF/Schubfach-LICENSE
  fast_double_parser (by Daniel Lemire, in FastDoubleParser)   BSL-1.0       META-INF/FastDoubleParser-ThirdParty-LICENSE
  fast_float (in FastDoubleParser)                             MIT           META-INF/FastDoubleParser-ThirdParty-LICENSE
  bigint (by Tim Buktu, in FastDoubleParser)                   BSD-2-Clause  META-INF/FastDoubleParser-ThirdParty-LICENSE

Keeping this file correct
-------------------------

A test over the assembled distribution (DistributionNoticesIT in the skillroy-cli module) fails the build when this
file and lib/ disagree: a third-party jar in lib/ that is not listed above (or a listed one that is gone or has
another version), a licence outside the allowed list, a licence or notice file inside a jar that is not mentioned
here, or a missing LICENSE, NOTICE or THIRD-PARTY.txt. Change the dependencies, then update this file.
